footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Organogenesis: after $17.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 17.0% to $564M in 2025. Gross margin was 75.6%, versus 76.0% a year earlier, and operating income was $44.7M, up from a $1.3M loss.
Net income was $20.0M, or $0.15 per share, after a $937K loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was −$10.3M and free cash flow −$24.5M, versus $4.2M.
